notes: §1985:XIII.2.4.3 SR3: "The availability of specific clauses in the I-O-CONTROL paragraph for a report file is dependent on the level of Sequential I-O module supported by the implementation." The compiler implements the Sequential I-O module at its full level (SAME RECORD AREA, MULTIPLE FILE TAPE and RERUN are all bound at 85), so every clause of the Report Writer I-O-CONTROL format is available for a report file: FileControlBinder.BindIoControl dispatches SAME to ScreenSameOperands/ScreenSameClauses and MULTIPLE FILE TAPE to ScreenMultipleFileClause, at every edition (the SAME SORT AREA arm of the companion SR2 is a separate PARTIAL). Probes at 85 (work-slice-54/c3*, c4*; classes b, c, e): SAME AREA FOR RPT-FILE OTH-FILE, MULTIPLE FILE TAPE CONTAINS RPT-FILE POSITION 1 OTH-FILE, both together, and RERUN ON CKPT EVERY 10 RECORDS OF RPT-FILE / EVERY END OF REEL OF RPT-FILE compile and run; SAME RECORD AREA with a report file is refused (COBOL2738, SR2); APPLY COMMIT is refused as a 2023 clause (COBOL0900). The witness's SAME AREA plus MULTIPLE FILE TAPE with a report file runs and prints I-O-CONTROL OK.

next.reason: 1985: "availability of specific clauses in the I-O-CONTROL paragraph for a report file is dependent on the level of Sequential I-O module"; 2023: "No module levels; SR-12.4.6.4.3-5 fixes it: report file may be in one file-area SAME clause, not record-area or sort-merge". 2023 has no module levels. Report-file use of I-O-CONTROL clauses is stated directly (SAME file-area only), so the level dependency is gone.
